approval_required_for: Any change to hidden_size, head_dim, query-head mapping, or other model-shape values not directly established by authoritative model inputs
Any new adapter, template substitution, template-internal change, or architecture change to make the current bindings legal

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the selection blocked, preserve all authoritative input values, and route any field-level conflict to the cross-layer evidence gate for source reconciliation. Do not alter dimensions, choose an adapter, or waive legality.
executable_actions.rationale: Compare the explicit parameter-binding citations with the field-level model_config and field_evidence, then rerun the applicable static checks. This action resolves evidence provenance without inventing or changing a model dimension.

executable_actions.on_failure: Report any missing or untrusted mapping with its operator and source reference, preserve the supplied operator order, and keep promotion blocked until the checker-grounded discrepancy is resolved.
executable_actions.rationale: Produce a checker-grounded operator-to-template coverage record from the supplied sequence, selected templates, source checks, and attention expansion. Record residual sequence placement separately from operand wiring.

observations: Coverage reports 11 required operators and 11 covered operators, with a block wrapper and no missing operators. The listed order maps as follows: rms_norm_input -> Norm.scala/norm; self_attention -> Attention.scala/attention; rms_norm_post_attention -> Norm.scala/norm; residual_add_1 -> Residual.scala/residual; rms_norm_pre_ffn -> Norm.scala/norm; mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, and mlp_down_proj -> FFN.scala/ffn; activation_mul -> Elementwise.scala/elementwise; rms_norm_post_ffn -> Norm.scala/norm; residual_add_2 -> Residual.scala/residual. The selected block wrapper is DecoderBlock.scala/decoder_block.

Required attention coverage is reported for QKV projection and RoPE in DecoderBlock.scala (SHA-256 ec517051054fb006bd56e9012481f6b412cff3834ba98e4bfe66539b3cecf785), GQA mapping in QKVProjection.scala (3ca84ba8f25c4f151d9bba237fbf61f1c2ca64b572dc02a1e570e8649a546bc1), softmax in Softmax.scala (4f68287b82eab429fa5da62a9d8f3fd1a537f00ef42e364f411e7dd3537e94f2), output projection in Attention.scala (c3e8bfc0ab0c1c8d4421bb0fe03272f4ea420df3f0e710b6a3c4154843593a7e), and causal mask in Mask.scala (bfb70e48641d60c25100b8240d5fef461aa954847c5fe5777b7fbb5445fc0e0a). KV cache is explicitly not required. GQA values are 4 query heads, 1 KV head, group size 4.

The supplied operator_sequence places residual_add_1 after rms_norm_post_attention and residual_add_2 after rms_norm_post_ffn, with the pre-FFN norm before the MLP operators. This confirms the listed sequence order; explicit residual operand/dataflow edges are not included in the supplied artifact, so this review does not claim to verify operand wiring.

The parameter bindings cite constraint.shape.model.hidden_size=1152, head_dim=256, and num_q_heads=4. Those represented values yield 1024 projected query dimensions, a 128-dimension discrepancy. The checker reports the same incompatibility for gemma3_text_block and self_attention. This supports the reported mismatch as currently bound, but the underlying model_config and field_evidence rows are not shown for an independent source-value comparison.

Other cited bindings include intermediate_size=6912, target_max_seq_len=16, num_kv_heads=1, and norm epsilon 1e-6. Numeric policy, board memory, runtime, deployment, and cross-layer consistency are present in the trace, which reports pass. No model-tail operators appear in the listed Transformer-block sequence.

operator_coverage_check, template_source_and_interface_check, mandatory_fpga_ip_binding_check, attention_semantic_expansion_check, and cross_layer_trace_check report pass. template_parameter_binding_check reports fail on the two hidden-size/head-dimension legality errors; the wrapper and attention bindings are incomplete.
proposed_actions: Have the binding/numeric and cross-layer evidence peers reconcile the cited shape bindings against the field-level authoritative model inputs; retain the current dimensions unless that evidence establishes a different binding.

Hand the listed operator/template mapping and the residual-order evidence limitation to the attention-semantic and cross-layer evidence peers. Do not treat sequence order as proof of residual operand wiring.
Do not promote the selection while the parameter-binding checker reports the hidden-size/head-dimension legality errors.
risks: Current-stage blocker: the bound wrapper and self-attention parameters are illegal under the stated relation hidden_size = num_q_heads * head_dim. The supplied evidence does not authorize choosing a corrected hidden size or head dimension.
The field-level model_config and field_evidence values are not visible in this summary, limiting an independent provenance cross-check of the shape bindings.
Explicit residual operand/dataflow connections are not present in the artifact; sequence ordering alone does not establish residual wiring.

artifacts: operator coverage matrix with source/template references

output.summary: All 11 listed decoder operators have selected trusted templates, and required attention subcomponents are covered. The bound model-shape values support the reported hidden-size/head-dimension mismatch: 1152 != 4 * 256 (1024). The raw model_config and field_evidence values are not expanded in the supplied summary, so the cited authoritative shape bindings cannot be independently cross-checked here. Do not change dimensions or select an adapter by inference.
